general.title: Full-Stack Developer
general.bio1: Hello! Welcome to my portfolio! I am a Web Developer passionate about technology. Here I'll showcase a bit of what I've done and what I'm currently developing, besides serving as a small portal to the past in the form of a nostalgic experience with classic Windows XP!
general.bio2: Although I did not start my academic and professional life in technology, it has always been working behind the scenes. I have a degree in Business Administration and a Master's degree in Sociology, both from UFPel. Professionally, I've worked on various fronts: from organizing events and accounting routines to working independently as an IT technician, solving hardware and software issues. I entered the programming field in 2023 when I realized I could solve some of the pain points of my work at the time through simple automation tools.
general.bio3: Today, my greatest technical background is in front-end, but I keep studying to diversify my skills: back-end, API development, AI integrations, optimizations, and architecture. I believe my past experiences, both academic and professional, have given me a unique set of perspectives that makes my work as a dev much more complete than it would be without them: soft skills, organization, systemic vision, ease of communication, focus on problem-solving, and a real understanding of the business.

items.title: Cost Optimization: AI vs. Regex
items.description: Not every complex problem demands an expensive solution. In a recent project, I encountered a flow that relied heavily on an Artificial Intelligence API to identify and validate strings in text, generating high operational costs. I analyzed the data patterns and replaced the entire AI integration with optimized regular expressions (Regex). The result? The same validation accuracy, with instant performance and a drastic reduction in infrastructure costs.

items.title: Agile Automation with Low-Code
items.description: During my experience in Porto Alegre, I focused on rapidly building solutions using low-code tools such as Bubble and Make (Integromat). More than just 'dragging blocks', the real challenge here was architectural modeling: understanding companies' manual processes, designing data flows, and integrating different APIs to make systems communicate with each other in an automated, invisible way for the end user.

items.title: Sustainable Software in Production
items.description: One of my greatest prides is not just delivering fast code, but delivering code that stands the test of time. Over two years ago, I developed an internal application for a company where I worked, and that system continues in full production use to this day, with no need for constant refactoring. This proves my focus on writing sustainable code, resilient architectures, and centering on what truly matters: solving the user's problem for the long run.

items.title: Front-end Developer
items.subtitle: NOC Project
items.description: Working since conception on building a NOC (Network Operations Center) system. Accelerated development using advanced Artificial Intelligence tools (LLMs) as code co-pilots, ensuring fast deliveries and a scalable architecture. Focus on creating efficient interfaces and optimizing costs and performance — including refactoring AI API-based validation flows into faster and more economical internal logic.

items.title: Junior Developer
items.subtitle: Grupo Elevato
items.description: Development of customized web solutions and process automation, acting as the bridge between business and technology. Created a lead management system (CRM) from scratch and a logistics tracker that eliminated internal package losses. Highlighted by substituting manual routines with systems that reduced price alteration time from hours to minutes. Strong focus on translating operational challenges into functional solutions.

items.title: IT Technician
items.subtitle: Freelancer
items.description: An extra income project that ended up being bigger than planned for a while. I provided hardware and software technical support services for end customers and some companies. It was a fantastic experience for developing my problem-solving perception and technical communication for clients.

items.title: Administrative and Operational Routines
items.subtitle: Various Companies
items.description: Diverse experiences dealing with the public, organizing events, and administrative routines. This period developed my resilience, emotional intelligence, and ability to work under pressure. The direct interaction with bottlenecks and manual processes in these areas was what motivated me to learn programming, seeking to create automations to optimize my own day-to-day in the accounting sector.

contact.intro: Feel free to get in touch!

credits.intro: This project was built on the shoulders of giants. Here are some of the main tools, libraries, and open-source resources that made this portfolio possible:

items.name: Webamp
items.description: A nostalgic and incredibly faithful recreation of the classic Winamp 2.91 player in HTML5 and JavaScript, built by Captbaritone. Used in the Winamp app.

items.name: React & Vite
items.description: The powerful engine behind the entire interface of our fake operating system, ensuring modularity when building windows and absurd performance.

items.name: @dnd-kit
items.description: A lightweight, modular, and accessible drag-and-drop toolkit. Used in the mechanics of the Solitaire game.

items.name: Zustand
items.description: A minimalist state manager that keeps track of which windows are open, z-index ordering (which screen is in front), and files.

items.name: Firebase
items.description: Google's ecosystem that brings the MSN Messenger app to life, providing a real-time database for global chats.

items.name: Windows XP Assets
items.description: Most of the original icons and sounds belong to and were created by Microsoft Corporation. They are being used here under fair use strictly as a nostalgic homage.
